lines.label: B1
lines.reason: The line runs along the root fold between base plate outer skin 2 and arm outer skin 6, measured at 90.1 deg. In my sections at 25%, 50% and 75% the line sits on the vertex of the outer arc, with the nearest scan point 0.02, 0.05 and 0.03 mm away. The scan's apex band runs from t -0.16 to 17.74 and the line from 0 to 17.6, about 98% coverage. Past the relief slot (t<0) there is only the flat plate wing (inner skin 1 plus outer skin 2), so the fold does not continue there. Past t=19 there is no material.

lines.label: B2
